name: lc_silo_lift
note: On reserve, placed nowhere (the owner, 24 November: save the lift and its grates for later): the silo's lift as it last worked (23 November, before the silo was cut to its top floor). Valve's White Forest lift car (func_tracktrain lc_silo_lift_2 with its car and door models) on a path of two stops 1088 apart (lc_silo_lift_stop_0 at the bottom landing, lc_silo_lift_stop_1 at the walkway); at each landing a pair of gates that slide (func_button movers) and a call button (freightelevatorbutton02); in the car an up and a down button; the logic that sends it, opens and shuts the gates and waits for the way to be clear (relays, compares, branches); and at the top the walkway's two sliding grates (lc_silo_lift_grates) that cover the shaft's mouth while the car is away and slide back as it comes up, only once the hole is clear (lc_silo_lift_hole), with their sound. Round it the shaft: Valve's walls, pillars and landing frames, and at the two levels it passed its own panel, pipes and wire fence (Silo.shaft_shut). Anchor: the bottom landing's floor in the shaft's middle (map 9792 5824 -1240 in the bunker's test build). Its maker, BunkerForest.lift() in map_forest.py, is still there, unplaced. Names keep their lc_silo_ prefix.
